title: Divider
text: 使用 S 参数对理想的频率无关分路器或合路器进行建模；按 {Reference impedances (Ohm)} 指定分路器的参考阻抗；{Select component} 指定分路器类型 T power、{Number of divider outports} 指定 Wilkinson 功率分路器的输出端口数、{Ground and hide negative terminals} 指定 RF 电路端子接地，按实例取值。

params.name: Select component
params.values: 分路器类型 T power divider (default) | Resistive power divider | Wilkinson power divider | Tee H-plane (S33=0) | Tee E-plane

params.name: Number of divider outports
params.values: Wilkinson 功率分路器的输出端口数 2 (default) | nonnegative integer in the range ( 1, 65 ]

params.name: Reference impedances (Ohm)
params.values: 分路器的参考阻抗 50 (default) | positive scalar | three-tuple vector

params.name: Ground and hide negative terminals
params.values: RF 电路端子接地 on (default) | off
